topic: Full Stack Integration: React, Node.js, Express, and Database
learningObjectives: Trace data flow between a React frontend, backend API, and database.
Connect frontend components to backend REST endpoints.
Design a complete full stack application architecture.

activities.title: Full Stack Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore the major layers of a complete full stack application.

content.concept: A full stack application connects a frontend interface to a backend API, application logic, and persistent database storage.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Displays the user interface and collects user interactions.
Defines HTTP endpoints through which the frontend communicates with the backend.
Contains validation, business logic, authentication, and application processing.
Carries processed data back to the frontend for rendering.

activities.title: End-to-End Data Flow
activities.instruction: Click each stage to trace data from the UI to the database and back.

content.concept: A user action can trigger a frontend request, backend processing, database access, and a response that updates the React interface.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The user performs an action such as submitting a form.
The React component handles the interaction and initiates the request.
The Express route receives and directs the HTTP request.
Backend logic validates and processes the operation.
The database stores or retrieves the required data.
The backend returns the operation result to the frontend.
React uses the returned data to update the interface.

activities.title: Integration Sequence
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a complete full stack request.

content.concept: A typical full stack request travels from a React component through an API route and backend logic to the database, then returns data to the frontend.

activities.title: Full Stack Feature Builder
activities.instruction: Compose the layers required to implement a complete feature.

content.concept: A complete full stack feature coordinates frontend components, API routes, backend services, database operations, and response handling.
